_about: T.S.R.A. deployment notices: the screen between PLAY and the loading bar (scripts/UI/menu/mission_briefing.gd), one block per levels/levels.json entry, keyed by its "id". Voice: a cold contractor-services department. Personnel are line items, losses are figures, nothing is explained. The 'reports' are the only human voices, and they stay plain and understated: no entity names, no how-to, no monsters described outright, just one ordinary detail that is wrong. Fields: file_no (DEPLOYMENT FILE), assignment, objective, situation, terms (TERMS OF DEPLOYMENT), reports ([{source, reliability, text}]: PRIOR MATERIAL), investigate (DATA REQUIREMENTS; leave out when there are none), orders (CONDUCT POLICY), sign_off, and optionally ambience (a res:// path for the sound bed; the hollow drone when absent). "_default" is used for any level id not listed here.

_default.objective: Survey the sector. Record any deviation from baseline. Locate an exit.
_default.situation: No prior deployments on file for this sector.
terms: Readings are accepted in the event of non-return.
Recovery of personnel is not a contracted service.
orders: Do not follow other personnel. No other personnel are assigned to this sector.
_default.sign_off: Thank you for your continued cooperation.

tsra_hub.assignment: LAUNCH BAY 1 // BASELINE SURVEY // TIER 1 CONTRACT
tsra_hub.objective: Report to Launch Bay 1. Engage the threshold lever and enter when the gate stands open. Record baseline readings across the entry stratum. Locate the exit. Document the route to it.
tsra_hub.situation: Level 0 is rated stable. Fourteen contractors have been deployed under this file. Nine returns are on record. Two of the returning contractors do not appear on the original deployment roster.
terms: Equipment remains T.S.R.A. property. Losses are deducted from settlement.
Readings are accepted in the event of non-return.
Recovery of personnel is not a contracted service.

reports.text: Room here's set up like a shop floor. Display figures, maybe thirty. They all face the door except one. I'm going to go around.
Someone is standing at the far end of the corridor. I have been walking toward them for forty minutes. They have not gotten any bigger.

reports.source: RECOVERED ITEM // UNDERSIDE OF A CEILING TILE
reports.text: don't walk under the dark parts. go around. it's longer. go around.

investigate: Rooms whose occupant count changes between observations.
Figures that hold a fixed distance regardless of approach.
Unpowered ceiling sections. Record from a distance. Do not pass beneath.
Corridors whose measured length differs on return.
orders: Maintain walking pace. Running voids medical coverage.
Do not follow other personnel. No other personnel are assigned to this sector.
Do not respond to your name.
tsra_hub.sign_off: Thank you for your continued cooperation.

level_2_yellow_halls.assignment: DEEP SURVEY // TIER 3 CONTRACT // RECOVERY CLAUSE
level_2_yellow_halls.objective: Re-map the service corridors beneath Level 0. Recover equipment issued to Survey Team WREN. Serial numbers are on file.
level_2_yellow_halls.situation: Maps of this level expire within days. Team WREN deployed with four contractors. Their beacon has reported four contractors in motion for eleven days. Last voice contact was on day two.
terms: WREN equipment recovered intact qualifies for a completion bonus.
Personnel recovery is not in scope.
Readings are accepted in the event of non-return.

reports.text: Hale's ahead of me, I can see her light. She's going back the way we came in. She stopped where I stopped. She's doing it in the same order.
Man standing at the junction. He was there on the way in. Hasn't moved. He was facing the wall before.
AUDIO EVENT 03:41. DURATION 6 S. CLASSIFICATION: VOCAL, HUMAN. NO WREN PERSONNEL REGISTERED AS SPEAKING.

investigate: Personnel in T.S.R.A. equipment not listed on your deployment.
Stationary figures at junctions. Record orientation on each pass.
Audio events with no visible source. Record duration only.
Wet carpet at wall junctions. Sample. Do not remain.
orders: If you encounter Team WREN, do not engage. Report their position.
level_2_yellow_halls.sign_off: Thank you for your continued cooperation.
